summary: VitalsBeyond is an autonomous, offline-first deep-space health and environmental monitoring command center engineered to safeguard astronauts on long-duration missions to Mars and beyond. By seamlessly integrating real-time space weather radiation telemetry, cumulative dosimetry tracking, and organ-specific tissue absorption metrics with a planetary proximity distance calculator and physical vital signs dashboard, the platform bridges the gap between environmental hazards and physiological health. Crucially, it redefines crew care by embedding a holistic behavioral wellness suite and an empathetic conversational AI companion that provides mental grounding while passively converting daily check-ins into structured clinical data for flight surgeons—delivering a unified, mission-critical safety solution designed to function independently across deep-space communication blackouts.
details: The project is mainly based on python. We implemented various python libraries such as Flet, Numpy, matplotlib and many more. The usage of various graphs help the in visualising the data of their vital organs. Moreover, the usage of radiation monitoring system in the vitalsbeyond Project helps them to safeguard from the intense radiation of the sun while they are on their spacecraft.
